title: Exclude neutral-first G20 two-step savings across all native catalogue routes (no new κ)
body:
On the final #5708 word, none of the 49,865 second A2 rewrites after any of its 22 neutral first moves lowers the complete local paid-query moment: 49,392 strict losses and 473 attained ties, for every real 0<t<1. Each frame demand may use any finite separately charged path through all 52,624 native edges on 645 frames. The complete first-step census also gives 2,248 strict losses and 22 ties.

New relative to #6290/#6305: neutral-first depth two and the full native catalogue, extending the published directed route table. #5616 supplies related catalogue geometry for a different, scalar-order-preserving problem; its old caller/flow certificate is not transferred.

Base: 2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc.
#5708 source: 829d01fc031f7323ffcfa423fdfd1f24dcbe3190. Individual input Git/SHA256 pins and question-head pins are in SOURCES.json and TASK.json; no pending executable is imported.

Reproduce (CPython 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-neutral-two-step-obstruction
```
Expected: PASS_G20_NATIVE_NEUTRAL_TWO_STEP (49865 / 49392 / 473) and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed: six registered commands; normal/optimized full censuses; every 685-column endpoint and final return; independent complete interval scan, geometry, all 416,025 integer distances, 211 sign proofs and prefix-reuse checks. Full-from-start and prefix invoices agree entry by entry. Thirty-six actual corruptions reject. Committed bytes/modes, export integrity and all six read-only Git-free replays pass. Exhaustive deterministic domain, stopped at depth two; no all-depth search claim. Complete remote tree matches tested contents.

No new κ. Correction frames and catalogue are fixed; each demand pays separately. Costly-first compensation, deeper rewrites, new frames and shared/cancelled demands remain open. Ordinary work, uniform native admission, compiler/precision/tape, full caller and all five framework assumptions remain inherited or unrun. No hosted CI, proof-kernel acceptance or complete-history preflight claimed.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate domain, algebraic and implementation reviews. Credit Ali Romman (#5708/#5616), unpaidmoon (#6290), Nick Petalas (#6305), and retained native/controller lineage. Apache-2.0.
